summary: StudentPRPreferences manages student placement request preferences, including adding, updating, deleting, and retrieving statistics about placements and preferences. The system ensures business rules relating to maximum preferences and duplication are enforced.
purpose: To enable students (or administrators on behalf of students) to add, update, or delete placement request preferences, and to retrieve statistics about available and new placements. The system enforces rules regarding the maximum number of preferences and prevents duplicate requests for the same destination.

fields.name: AnyDestInSite
fields.description: Boolean flag indicating if any destination within the site is acceptable.

fields.name: AnySiteDestInService
fields.description: Boolean flag indicating if any site within the service is acceptable.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the preference entry.

fields.name: TimetableID
fields.description: Identifier for the relevant timetable context.

fields.name: TotalPlacementsAvailable
fields.description: Statistic: count of all available placements for the student.

fields.name: NewPlacementsSinceLastLogin
fields.description: Statistic: count of new placements since the student's last login.

actors.name: Student
actors.description: The primary actor whose preferences are managed.

actors.name: Administrator
actors.description: May add, update, or delete preferences on behalf of students.

workflows.name: Add Student Placement Preference
steps: Invoke Add method with session, studentID, prdID.
If SQL error occurs, check error type:
If error is 'Number of Preferences exceeds maximum', display appropriate message.
If error is 'Duplicate destination', display duplicate destination error message.

workflows.name: Update Student Placement Preference
steps: Invoke Update method with session, id, ranking, anyDestInSite, anySiteDestInService.
Add parameters: SessionID, ID, Ranking, AnyDestInSite, AnySiteDestInService.

workflows.name: Delete Student Placement Preference
steps: Invoke Delete method with session and preference id.

workflows.name: Retrieve Student Preference Statistics
steps: Invoke GetStatistics method with session, timetableID, studentID.
Extract TotalPlacementsAvailable and NewPlacementsSinceLastLogin from results.
Close data reader and return statistics.

business_rules: Number of student preferences may not exceed a configured maximum.
Duplicate destination preferences are not allowed.
Error messages are localized and contextualized based on the error type.
validations: Check for maximum number of preferences before adding.
Check for duplicate destinations before adding.
calculations: TotalPlacementsAvailable: Count of available placements for student.
NewPlacementsSinceLastLogin: Count of new placements since student's last login.
conditions: If SQLErrorOccured in Add, check error type to determine which message to show.
system_behavior: Uses stored procedures for Add, Update, Delete, and Stats retrieval.
Localizes error messages based on session context.
Ensures DB operations are wrapped with parameter handling and error management.
exceptions: NumberOfPreferencesExceeded: thrown when adding would exceed maximum.
DuplicateDestination: thrown when adding duplicate preference.
